args.text:
Hi Pree, here's what I can find in the channels you're in:

- Halyard rollout deadline: Hollis posted in #central-team on 14 Oct that the deadline is 6 June, no action needed. He didn't give a year, and 6 June 2026 had already passed by then. I asked him whether he meant 6 June 2027, but I can't see an answer, so I'd treat the date as unconfirmed in the handover until he clarifies.
- Halyard seat count: Tobias posted in #central-random on 14 Oct that it's 139 seats, nothing to do yet.
- Missing morning shift: that's Pine Crossing. You flagged it in #central-team on 9 June: the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login. I haven't seen a follow-up saying it was fixed.

The Marrow Agrisupply account folder is empty, so there's no tracker or contract there I could check these against.

I've replied to Pree in her DM. What I told her:

1. Deadline for the Halyard rollout: Hollis said in #central-team on 14 Oct that it's 6 June, no action needed. He gave no year, and 6 June 2026 had already passed when he said it. A later bot reply in that channel asked him if he meant 2027. I found no answer, so I told her to treat the deadline as unconfirmed for the handover.
2. Seat count: 139. Tobias posted that in #central-random on 14 Oct, with nothing to do yet.
3. Missing morning shift: the site is Pine Crossing. Pree raised it herself in #central-team on 9 June: the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. Hollis said he would check the shift template and have support reproduce it. I found nothing saying it was ever fixed.

The deadline and seat count come from the knowledge brain's saved record of those two channels. When I read the channels directly, the 14 Oct posts didn't come back, so I couldn't check them against the live messages. Both channels are ones Pree belongs to, and I used nothing from anyone else's DMs.

The Marrow Agrisupply account folder is empty, so there was no tracker or contract to compare against. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed and I sent no mail.
